situations.summary: Deansgate-Castlefield & Trafford Bar - Tram Improvement Works
situations.detail: On Sunday 6 September, from the start of service until 11am, tram improvement works will take place at Deansgate-Castlefield and Trafford Bar. During this time, no trams will operate on the Eccles, Trafford Centre and Altrincham lines, with further service changes in place across the network. A replacement bus service will operate between the affected stops.
Due to road closures in place for the Altrincham 10K run, some bus services will follow a diversion, operate later in the day or may experience delays.

From 6 September, this route will join Liverpool City Region’s Metro network. There will also be changes to the times of all journeys, with some improvements to early morning and late evening journeys.
